ash: Heads-up — planning a 50m hands-on webinar focused on attendee routing into 3 concurrent labs. Need quick plan for registration fields, HubSpot mapping, and Zoom preassigns. Who can own? :wave:
mira: I can wire HubSpot -> Zoom mapping. Proposal: hidden field `lab_choice` + HubSpot list membership -> webhook -> Zoom preassign API.
dave: I'll run the labs (demo lead) and prepare a low-bandwidth recording fallback. Each lab needs a 10-12 min guided exercise + 3 min debrief.
leah: APAC note: schedule the live session at 11am PT so we catch APAC afternoon. Also add a localization Q&A breakout.
ash: (typo, ignored)
ash: sorry, meant ash: ops-bot, can Zoom preassign against registration emails? Rate limits?
ops-bot: zoom-provisioner: yes — Zoom supports preassign via registration email mapping. Rate limits: 1 request/sec for bulk API; recommend batch preassigner job. Pre-create 3 breakout rooms.
mira: Routing sketch:
```
1) Registration form -> hidden `lab_choice` (A/B/C)
2) HubSpot workflow tags contact with `lab_choice`
3) Preassign job matches emails -> Zoom via API
4) Fallback: host/manual move + moderator list in chat
```
I'll implement webhook so no CSVs.
dave: Run-of-show (50m):
00:00-05:00 intro + setup
05:00-20:00 Lab rotations (3x 5m mini-intros + 10m hands-on)
20:00-35:00 Breakouts + moderator prompts
35:00-45:00 Cross-room highlights
45:00-50:00 CTA + next steps

I'll record a 3-min low-bandwidth fallback and a local laptop script: `if stream fails -> share fallback URL -> continue Qs`.
leah: Moderation: each lab needs 1 lead + 1 floater (tech) and a pinned chat doc with prompts. Also ask HubSpot to capture `joined_lab` events.
mira: HubSpot events: `registered`, `attended_live`, `joined_lab:{lab}` and `clicked_cta`. We'll use these to trigger follow-ups: joined -> trial CTA, no-show -> recording + nudge.
